meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将频道连接到代理组并管理隔离级别
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理多个频道与代理组的映射关系
copy.tagline_en: Wire channels to agent groups and manage isolation levels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage mappings between channels and agent groups

howto.what: 装上后,当你需要把聊天渠道(如 Telegram、Slack)接给某个智能体、调整隔离级别或新增渠道群时,Claude 会先查当前配置,再引导你提供平台 ID 和隔离选项,并执行注册或改接。
howto.when: 当你添加新渠道、搭建初期或想重新配置渠道与智能体分组时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下现在哪些渠道已接入、哪些还没配。
say.note: 会读取数据库并汇总渠道状态。

say.text: 把这个 Slack 渠道改接到另一个智能体分组。
say.note: 会执行改接,旧会话保留在原分组。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you need to connect a messaging channel (Telegram, Slack, etc.) to an agent group, adjust isolation levels, or add a channel group, Claude will inspect the current configuration, ask for the platform ID and isolation choice, and run the registration or rewiring.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you add a new channel, during initial setup, or when reconfiguring how channels are wired to agent groups.

say_en.text: Show me which channels are wired and which are not configured yet.
say_en.note: Reads the database and summarizes channel status.

say_en.text: Move this Slack channel to another agent group.
say_en.note: Rewires it; old sessions stay with the original group.
